metadata.title: IYTE Mobile - Simplify Campus Life
metadata.description: Campus life application developed for Izmir Institute of Technology students

hero.title: Simplify Your
hero.subtitle: Designed for IYTE students, all campus life in one app. Social feed, food menus, bus schedules, messaging and much more.

features.sectionSubtitle: Features that touch every moment of campus life

socialFeed.title: Social Feed
socialFeed.description: Stay connected with posts, confessions, polls, likes, comments and bookmarks.

chat.title: Instant Messaging
chat.description: Private messages, group chats and department chat rooms to stay in touch.

food.title: Food Menus
food.description: Daily cafeteria and dorm menus, campus restaurants and user ratings.

transport.title: Bus Schedules
transport.description: IYTE shuttle services, ESHOT connections, weekday and weekend schedules.

carpool.title: Carpooling
carpool.description: Create ride-sharing listings, find affordable inter-city transportation.

clubs.title: Clubs & Events
clubs.description: Discover campus clubs, follow events, share your reviews.

documents.title: Academic Documents
documents.description: Department-wise exam papers, lecture notes and project files sharing.

jobs.title: Job Listings
jobs.description: Discover internship, part-time, freelance and full-time job opportunities.

badges.title: Badges & Gamification
badges.description: Earn XP, level up, compete on the leaderboard and conquer campus.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Never miss anything with event, message and social interaction notifications.

profile.title: Profile & Privacy
profile.description: Personalized profile, social media links and privacy controls.

featureDetail.socialDesc: Stay in touch with campus through a Twitter-like social feed. Regular posts, anonymous confessions, polls and more. A full social experience with likes, comments, bookmarks and follow features.
featureDetail.chatDesc: Send private messages to friends, create group chats or join your department's chat room. Stay connected with online status, typing indicators and instant notifications.
featureDetail.foodDesc: Instantly access daily cafeteria and dorm menus. Discover campus restaurants, browse their menus, read reviews and rate them yourself.
featureDetail.transportDesc: Track IYTE shuttle schedules, ESHOT connection times and carpooling listings all in one place. Weekday and weekend schedules can be viewed separately.

download.sectionSubtitle: Now live on Android, coming soon on iOS!

cta.title: Transform Your
cta.subtitle: Take your campus experience to the next level with IYTE Mobile.

clubApplication.title: Create Your Club on IYTE Mobil
clubApplication.subtitle: Fill out the form below to submit your club application. Approved clubs can publish events and interact with students on IYTE Mobil.

hints.logoUrl: If you already have a logo URL, paste it here.

success.title: Application Sent
success.description: Your club application has been received. Our team will review it and contact you by email.

errors.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
